observations.isometric: Reviewed final sectioned casting with main/lower gears. Lug and rear screw support now give the previously unsupported unit a coherent receiving structure; curved casting blends remain estimates.
observations.longitudinal: Compared with LIB107 and SNL14: lower vertical drive, long horizontal retaining screw, rear pump opening and bottom well are in the source arrangement.184mm axis drop and all cast profiles are unregistered estimates; complete pumps absent.
observations.underside: Compared with LIB96: larger circular opening retains the lower driver near one side, rather than recentering it. The complete mounting rim is visible. Source pump studs and oil-tube openings are not yet represented; source camera not matched.
observations.case_only: Reviewed the integral cylindrical support, open upper annular oil-entry recess and shortened lower lug end above the pump opening. Display section exposes interior; the saved case is one integral solid.
observations.screw_support: Compared with SNL19 sectional support: printed screw length spans the blind housing seat and external cast boss. Top oil ports remain above the lug. Housing windows still use approximate rounded rectangular contours; further source-profile refinement remains required.
observations.pump_interface: Reviewed rear mounting opening and bottom mounting rim together. Profiles provide candidate space for future conical pump retainer, but do not establish its fit or mounting-hole pattern.

status: Source-informed approximate receiving geometry; complete pumps, attachment features, historical dimensional registration and standard integration unfinished
oil_entry_interpretation: LIB88 labels prove radial ports; separate edge notches remain uncertain, not an automatic missing feature.
cleanup: Extra same-domain seam edges are retained because optional unification increased kernel tolerance; material is unchanged.
